laws.rule: Étretat cliffs (Seine-Maritime): the mayor's order no. 180/2025 of 28 April 2025 bans physical access to the Chambre des Demoiselles and the Descente au Chaudron, and to the tunnels through the cliff points (including the Trou-à-l'Homme tunnel). It bans access to the beaches across their full width along the whole commune except in front of the promenade sea wall, and bans walking on the clifftop plateaux (Amont and Aval) within at least 5 metres of the break of slope. Breaking the order is a second-class contravention fine, and the fire service can charge its costs for non-urgent rescues. Other mayor's orders on the same page cover barbecues and open fires on public land, pets on public land, and bikes and motor vehicles on the shore.
laws.heading: Ville d'Étretat, arrêté n°180/2025 réglementant la promenade sur le littoral
laws.penalty_signal: Second-class contravention fine (article R.610-5, Code pénal); the order's article 8 also allows the fire service to charge its non-urgent intervention costs.

sources.title: Arrêté n°180/2025 réglementant la promenade sur le littoral
